acv.quote: We proposed six hundred K a year.

header.reason: Lost to Adyen on the store side. Angela, the COO, signed after we offered a partner for installs and never showed a till return. Tom credits the web side, but stores decided it.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Lead with returning an online order at a store, not channel talk.

line.text: Unify online and in-store commerce: the line between online and in-store has all but disappeared

findings.why: Angela, the COO, reportedly watched the returns queue after stores couldn't see online orders.
findings.quote: The store couldn't see the online order

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Tell the COO one vendor answers for both stores and web.

line.text: Stripe Terminal is a point of sale system that unifies your online and offline channels

findings.why: Angela signed with Adyen. Tom met her once, at the kickoff, and worked mostly with Raj, the CTO.
findings.quote: I don't want two vendors pointing at each other.

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: Show our store rollout experience and name retailers running our tills.

line.text: URBN consolidates $5 billion in online and in-store revenue onto Stripe

findings.why: Raj told Tom that Adyen brought a store rollout team. Afterwards, 11 of their 14 questions were about stores.
findings.quote: they came in with a retail team, people who'd done store rollouts

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Replace the line has disappeared slide with a step-by-step till return.

line.text: Unify online and in-store commerce: the line between online and in-store has all but disappeared

findings.why: Bev, head of store operations, dismissed the slide and asked how a return works at the till.

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Add a retailer story buyers can call, with real rollout dates and installs.

line.text: URBN consolidates $5 billion in online and in-store revenue onto Stripe

findings.why: Angela asked to talk to the fashion retailer in our case study, and we couldn't arrange a call in time.

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Say 'the tills' and 'one customer, one basket', not 'point of sale'.

line.text: Stripe Terminal is a point of sale system that unifies your online and offline channels

findings.why: Bev used this phrase every time, and they never said 'unified commerce'.
findings.quote: One system for the tills and the website.
